result_text:
Promotions now carry an optional description, and it comes back in all six places you listed. The full suite passes offline (608 tests).

What changed:
- **`schema.sql`**: new nullable `description VARCHAR(255)` column on `promotion`.
- **`model/Promotion.java`**: `description` added as the last record component. Null means no description.
- **`service/PromotionService.java`**: new overload `createPromotion(code, discount, start, end, category, description)`. The existing 5-argument method delegates to it with `null`, so current callers are unchanged. A blank description is stored as null, the same way a blank category is treated.
- **`DataStore.java`**: the promotion insert writes the description. The six promotion reads (by code, active on date, active in region, by category, best for category on date, unused in period) select it and map it.
- **`PromotionTest.java`**: new `keepsDescriptionInEveryListing` test covering a promotion with a description and one without, across all six lookups.

Two notes:
- The `DataStore` edits for the six reads were made with the Edit tool. A scripted perl edit was blocked pending approval, so I did not run it.
- I did not add descriptions to the demo scenario, since the task didn't ask for it.

Nothing is committed.
